caption:
Jobs report is out. 💼

BLS says employers added 165,000 jobs in October and unemployment is 4.1%.

Average hourly pay is $38.00, up 3.1% over the past year.

Does your paycheck feel like it kept up with that?
first_comment: Did you get a raise this year? Be honest 👇
